BuffData buff_wpn_lance_0014_damageup: attributeType 2 formulaItem 6 (ATK +atk_up), stackingType 11 (independent layers, each with its own duration), maximum from max_stack. SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_lance_0014: atk_up 0.035 (L1) to 0.098 (L9), duration 20, max_stack 4.

Description (Medicant: Shimmering Curtain): when the wielder's skill heals another operator, that operator gains ATK for 20 s, up to 4 stacks, each operator at most once every 0.1 s. Logs: teammates' hits carry 1–4 layers of buff_wpn_lance_0014_damageup (0.098 at L9 in zmdlogs-bdf223db8e49 and -0eef2474a26f, 0.056 at L4 in -dbaee23b801d and -d9e59d0fb737); the wielder's own hits none.
The weapon's other effects (Will +156 at L9, Treatment Efficiency, main attribute +44.8%: cardAttributeModifier) are in the stat panel; Treatment Efficiency doesn't act on damage.

buffs.label: Medicant: Shimmering Curtain (ATK)
buffs.note: Given to the healed operator only (to: eventSubject); layers are kept per recipient, so each teammate has up to max_stack of its own.

triggers.note: Heals the wielder's kit declares (hit heals, trigger heals with their healKind); untagged heals (talents, potentials, gear) don't count. The 0.1 s limit is per healed operator.
